## Description (first paragraph)

Run a **connected-neighborhood pre-search** over the PRISM system graph for the task/topic in `$ARGUMENTS`. Unlike `/find` (flat top-K of unrelated hits), this returns the seeds PLUS their connected neighborhood -- so you see HOW the relevant assets relate (engine -> wired-to dispatcher -> documented-by wiki -> tested-by test), i.e. the route to approach the task with existing PRISM capabilities.
